Kit summary

Cross CleaveBasic
Deals 2 stages of DMG to a single enemy. The 1st stage deals DMG by 10% of self Max HP and the 2nd stage deals [Bleed] DMG by 10% of self Max HP. Each time after casting skills proactively, casts Cross Cleave to pursue and attack the main target once.
Shielded Spear ThrustActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of [Bleed] DMG by 10% of self Max HP each to all enemies. The 2nd stage inflicts [Cold II] on enemies whose initial Tenacity is lower than that of Nikilith for 1 turn.
Walls of Sanctuary Lv.3[Shelter of Faith]: Can be triggered once respectively when an ally's HP is below 66% and 33%. Meanwhile, when [Shelter of Faith] is triggered for the first time each wave, Nikilith will act for 1 extra turn. While Nikilith is under [Resonance Enhancement], she will grant [Reappearance] on the ally (excluding self) with the highest initial ATK when casting Shielded Spear Thrust. [Reappearance]: After the owner casts a skill proactively, they will cast the skill 1 more time and it will also be considered as proactively cast. Will be removed after it's triggered once.
Light of FaithPassiveExclusive Lv.1
Increases all allies' DMG dealt by 20% of self initial Tenacity, up to 24% can be increased.
Walls of Sanctuary Lv.1For every 30% HP lost by any ally, Nikilith will reduce all enemies' Tenacity and Mastery RES by 10% and increases self Tenacity and Mastery RES by 20% of the reduced amount. Each enemy's Tenacity and Mastery RES can be reduced by 100% at most. At the end of Nikilith's turns, she will copy the stolen Tenacity and Mastery RES to other allies.
Burdensome MercyActiveExclusive Lv.2
Cleanses all debuffs from all allies and grants them a [Compassion Shield] by 60% of self Max HP for 2 turns, up to 1 layer. Afterward, deals [Bleed] DMG by 15% of self Max HP to all enemies and enters [Resonance Enhancement] status for 2 turns. The CD of this skill cannot be affected by other effects.
Walls of Sanctuary Lv.2If Nikilith has the highest initial Tenacity among allies: 1. At the beginning of each wave, enters [Resonance Enhancement] for 1 turn. 2. The [Resonance Enhancement] status that she enters after casting Burdensome Mercy will last for 4 turns.
Light of Faith · ResonancePassiveExclusive Lv.1
While having [Resonance Enhancement]: 1. Self is immune to control effects. 2. Increases all allies' DMG dealt by 36% of self initial Tenacity, up to 43.2% can be increased. This effect will be reserved after Nikilith exits the [Resonance Enhancement] status. 3. Grants all allies [Shelter of Faith]: If the HP of an ally with [Shelter of Faith] is below 50% because of taking DMG from enemies, the ally only loses 1 point of HP when taking any DMG before the current turn ends. Each time after Nikilith enters [Resonance Enhancement] status, every ally can only trigger [Shelter of Faith] once.
Walls of Sanctuary Lv.1For every 30% HP lost by any ally, Nikilith will reduce all enemies' Tenacity and Mastery RES by 10% and increases self Tenacity and Mastery RES by 20% of the reduced amount. Each enemy's Tenacity and Mastery RES can be reduced by 100% at most. At the end of Nikilith's turns, she will copy the stolen Tenacity and Mastery RES to other allies.
